question: **Find the part of the sentence that contains an error**: The protest, though peaceful in nature, (1)/ were portrayed by official channels (2)/ as instigated by external forces (3)/ and ideologically driven groups. (4)
solution:
The correct answer is '2' i.e. were portrayed.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence states that the protest was peaceful in nature, but the verb “were portrayed” does not match the singular subject “The protest.”
 
• Since the subject is singular, the correct form of the verb should be **“was portrayed”**.
 
• In English, subject-verb agreement is essential: singular subjects take singular verbs, and plural subjects take plural verbs.

Correct sentence: *The protest, though peaceful in nature, **was portrayed** by official channels as instigated by external forces and ideologically driven groups*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Subject-Verb Agreement:**

 
 
• **Rule:** A singular subject requires a singular verb, and a plural subject requires a plural verb.
 
• **Example:** The cat **jumps** (singular subject), but the cats **jump** (plural subject).
 
 
 
• **Common Errors:**
 
 
• Mismatching singular subjects with plural verbs or vice versa.
 
• Misidentifying the subject due to intervening phrases or clauses.
